items.q: What does a website at SaaleWeb cost?
items.a: A compact WordPress one-pager starts at €600, a modern landing page at €990 and a full company website at €1,990. Individual systems with online booking, a shop or automation are quoted by scope — always as a transparent fixed price after a free initial call.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: A landing page is often live in 1–2 weeks, a full company website in 3–5 weeks. Larger projects with online booking, multiple languages or integrations are planned individually — you get a clear timeline from day one.

items.q: Is SEO included with every website?
items.a: Yes. Technical SEO, a clean page structure, fast load times, meta data and structured data are part of every project from the start. That's how you get found on Google in Halle, Leipzig and the region — and we can add dedicated SEO landing pages for individual services.

items.q: What do GEO and AIO — optimization for AI search — mean?
items.a: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AIO (AI Optimization) make sure AI systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity understand, correctly cite and recommend your business. We structure content semantically, add Schema.org structured data and answer real customer questions directly on the website.

items.q: How does my business appear in answers from ChatGPT & co.?
items.a: AI search systems prefer websites with clear facts: who you are, what you offer, where you work and what it costs. We prepare exactly this information in machine-readable form — with FAQ sections, LocalBusiness data and unambiguous service pages. That raises the chance that AI answers mention your business.

items.q: Do you do local SEO for Halle, Leipzig and Saalekreis?
items.a: Yes, that's our home turf. We optimize your website for local searches like "hairdresser Halle" or "roofer Merseburg", build location and service pages and connect everything with your Google Business Profile — for customers from Halle (Saale), Leipzig, Merseburg, Schkeuditz, Delitzsch and Saalekreis.

items.q: Do you also help with the Google Business Profile?
items.a: Yes. A well-maintained Google Business Profile brings visibility on Google Maps and in local search. We set up or optimize the profile, link it cleanly with the website and keep business data consistent — an important factor for local rankings.

Yes — German, English and Russian are part of our base setup, and further languages are available on request. Each language version gets its own URLs, clean hreflang links and adapted content, so you also reach international and Russian-speaking customers in the region.

items.q: WordPress or Next.js — which fits my project?
items.a: The technology follows the goal. WordPress is strong when you want to maintain content yourself in a proven system. Next.js/React shines with maximum speed, individual features and long-term scalability. In the free initial call we honestly recommend what fits your budget and plans.

items.q: I already have a website — is a relaunch worth it?
items.a: Often yes: if the site loads slowly, looks bad on smartphones, brings few inquiries or is invisible on Google, it costs you customers every day. We analyze the current state for free, keep the content that works and build a fast foundation with a clean SEO structure.

items.q: Can you integrate online appointment booking?
items.a: Yes. Whether hair salon, beauty studio, practice or trade business — we integrate online booking, calendar connections and automatic confirmations. Your customers book around the clock, you save phone time and never lose inquiries outside opening hours.

items.q: Can I edit content myself later?
items.a: Yes. From the Business package you get a simple CMS to update texts, images, prices and blog posts without any coding. Alternatively, we take care of updates as part of a maintenance package.

items.q: Do you offer hosting, maintenance and support?
items.a: Yes. We host on fast, secure infrastructure (including Vercel) and offer optional maintenance packages with updates, monitoring, backups and personal support. You have one direct contact person — no anonymous hotline.

items.q: How does a project at SaaleWeb work?
items.a: In six clear steps: free initial call, analysis of your goals, individual concept with a fixed price, design and development, joint launch — and support afterwards. You see interim states, give feedback and always know where the project stands.

items.q: Why not just a website builder like Wix — or only Instagram?
items.a: Builders and social media are a start, but rarely a foundation: limited SEO, generic design and dependence on platform rules. Your own professional website belongs to you, gets found on Google and in AI search and turns visitors into inquiries. Instagram complements that perfectly — but doesn't replace it.

items.q: Is the website built along GDPR principles?
items.a: Yes. Legal notice, privacy policy, SSL encryption and European hosting options are standard. Our own visitor statistics remain cookie-free; additional Google Analytics measurement is activated only with consent and can be withdrawn at any time.

items.q: Do you also work remotely or outside the region?
items.a: Yes. Our focus is Halle (Saale), Leipzig and Saalekreis — and we work just as reliably remotely for clients across Germany. Coordination happens comfortably via phone, WhatsApp or video call.

items.q: What do I need to get started?
items.a: Just your goal. For the free initial call, your current website (if you have one) and a short description of your offer are enough. Texts, images and structure are developed together — simply reach out via contact form, WhatsApp or phone.

ContactPage.faqTitle: Common questions before the first consultation

faq.q: What does a website with SaaleWeb cost?
faq.a: That depends on the scope: landing page, business website, relaunch, SEO or ongoing support. After the first consultation you receive a transparent fixed price instead of vague hourly estimates.

faq.q: Is the first consultation really free?
faq.a: Yes. The call is free and non-binding. We clarify whether we can help and which next step is realistic for your business.

faq.q: How long does a website project take?
faq.a: Small landing pages can be completed much faster than larger company websites. A few weeks is typical, depending on content, coordination and functionality.

faq.q: Is SEO included?
faq.a: The technical SEO foundation is part of a modern website. Broader SEO work such as keyword strategy, Local SEO, content and ongoing optimization is planned separately.

faq.q: Can SaaleWeb handle hosting and technical support?
faq.a: Yes. We can support hosting, performance, updates, monitoring and technical development so the website does not stagnate after launch.

faq.q: What does AI optimization or GEO mean?
faq.a: GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. Content is structured so AI systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overview can understand your business better.

faq.q: How does collaboration work?
faq.a: After your enquiry, we start with a free first consultation, then analysis, concept, fixed-price proposal, implementation, launch and optional ongoing support.

faq.q: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a: Yes. Many projects are optimized after launch: content, SEO, performance, new pages, technical care or conversion improvements.

faq.q: Does SaaleWeb work with businesses in Halle?
faq.a: Yes. SaaleWeb is based in Halle (Saale) and supports local businesses with Webdesign Halle, SEO Halle, Local SEO and digital lead generation.

faq.q: Does SaaleWeb also work for Leipzig?
faq.a: Yes. We also support businesses that need Webdesign Leipzig, SEO Leipzig or a modern website for customers in Leipzig and the surrounding area.

faq.q: Do I need finished texts and images?
faq.a: No. Existing material helps, but it is not required. Structure, content and priorities can be developed together.

faq.q: Can an existing website be modernized?
faq.a: Yes. A relaunch makes sense when design, technology, loading speed, SEO structure or conversion no longer fit the business.

faq.q: Does SaaleWeb work with fixed prices?
faq.a: Yes. Once the scope is clear, you receive an understandable proposal with defined services and transparent pricing.

faq.q: What happens directly after my enquiry?
faq.a: We review your details, ask follow-up questions if needed and reply within 24 hours with a proposal for the free first consultation.

faq.q: Will I own the website after completion?
faq.a: Yes. The website belongs to you. We focus on transparent handover, clean documentation and optional ongoing support.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: It depends on the scope. A modern business site starts in a clearly calculable range — transparent and with no hidden costs. In the free first call we give you a fixed price. You'll also find concrete packages on our pricing page.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Most projects go live in 3 to 6 weeks. The pace mainly depends on the content — and we actively help you prepare it.

faq.q: Can I edit the content myself later?
faq.a: Yes. You get a simple admin area to manage texts, images, prices and posts yourself — no technical knowledge required.

faq.q: Does the website really belong to me?
faq.a: 100 %. The code, content and domain are yours. No lock-in to website builders and no hidden licence fees.

faq.q: Do you support me after launch?
faq.a: Happily. On request we handle updates, security, backups and ongoing optimisation so your site keeps bringing enquiries.

faq.q: Does SaaleWeb also work with WordPress?
faq.a: Yes. We build, modernize, maintain and extend WordPress websites when WordPress is the right fit for the goal.

faq.q: Is SaaleWeb only a Next.js agency?
faq.a: No. Technology follows the goal. Depending on the task, we work with Next.js, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs or automation.

faq.q: Can SaaleWeb handle SEO?
faq.a: Yes. We build the technical and structural SEO foundation and can add Local SEO, content structure and ongoing optimization.

faq.q: Do you build online shops?
faq.a: Yes. We develop online shops with clear product structure, mobile user guidance, SEO foundations and optional product imports or integrations.

faq.q: Can existing systems be connected?
faq.a: In many cases yes. We review APIs, data structure and privacy requirements, then integrate CRM, booking, shop, calendar or other tools pragmatically.

faq.q: Do you use AI in projects?
faq.a: Yes, when it creates real value. Possible use cases include AI assistants, knowledge structure, inquiry preparation or internal support with clear control.

faq.q: Do you handle hosting and security?
faq.a: We advise on suitable infrastructure and can handle maintenance, updates, backups, form protection and practical website security.

faq.q: Do you guarantee Google rankings?
faq.a: No. Serious SEO work does not guarantee fixed rankings. We improve technology, structure, content and measurability transparently.
